'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jerry Heine LS Kashyyyk (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kashyyyk (V)|VB5-L-kashyyyk-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Seconded!
* '''Username:''' Queso
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
